prompt: Build a Move module for a tagged item collection on Sui. Items should have a name and a list of string tags. Include functions to create items, add tags, remove a tag by index, count tags, and check if a tag exists. Include unit tests.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
All tests pass with sui move test
Uses method syntax for vector operations (.push_back(), .length(), .remove())
Uses b"...".to_string() for string creation (not string::utf8)
Includes functions for add, remove, count, and contains

prompt: Write a Move module for a configuration registry on Sui where each config entry has a required key (String), a required value (u64), and an optional description (Option<String>). Include functions to set config (with or without description), read the value, check if a description exists, and extract the description. Include tests.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
All tests pass with sui move test
Uses method syntax for Option operations (.is_some(), .borrow(), .extract())
Config entries store Option<String> for optional description
Tests verify setting and extracting optional descriptions
